765-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-950-3043.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
512-950-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-3043.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

997-1981-2415-6273.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

7839-8041.description:
Activate Dizzying Gaze by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-6633.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1129-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
1129-4091-7791.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

2376-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

1542-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
1542-4499-7494.notes: If Wizards of Thay does not have summoning sickness, you may first attack and trigger Myriad, creating additional copies of them and causing this combo to add infinite mana.

224-1362-1772-3470.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
997-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-4222-5162-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Kwain does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Kwain.
2060-4222-5162-6996.description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Kwain.
Repeat.

914-3335-7296.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-7296.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-7296.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1563-2457-4365-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

225-539-6071-6844.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five permanent cards in your graveyard.
225-539-6071-6844.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
225-539-6071-6844.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

5147-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

3470-4693-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp.
3470-4693-5721-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {B/G} for each trigger.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

522-2099-2111.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

2060-2713-5140-6774.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-6774.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2403-2452-3249-5670--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2403-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2105-2923-5256.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, causing target player to mill cards equal to Combat Celebrant's power.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-2743-5461.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
851-2743-5461.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers four times and each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

997-1359-2366-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dryad Arbor on top of your library.
Galadriel's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal Dryad Arbor from the top of your library, and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1335-2440-2445.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2440-2445.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creture token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may repeat step 3 to give Marath infinite +1/+1 counters, then use them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3334-3899-4241-4871.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters.
3334-3899-4241-4871.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Spawning Pit to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn.
The Spawn dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1835-1912-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Zaxara.
Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1835-1912-2816.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Zaxara by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2615-3432-5016.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
2615-3432-5016.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Spitemare triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
